description: This file declares functions related to ETag handling and cache validation for HTTP responses within the lighttpd project.

methods.name: li_http_response_handle_cachable_etag
methods.description: Handles cache validation based on ETag for a given HTTP request and returns cache status.

methods.name: li_http_response_handle_cachable_modified
methods.description: Handles cache validation based on last modified time for a request.

methods.name: li_http_response_handle_cachable
methods.description: Determines if the HTTP response is cachable based on the request context.

methods.name: li_etag_mutate
methods.description: Mutates or updates the ETag value.

methods.name: li_etag_set_header
methods.description: Sets the ETag header for the HTTP response based on file stats.
